processCpu.limitation: CPU is a sampled lower bound: a process born and exited between samples, or CPU after its last sample, cannot be observed. pg_shared includes instance-wide background work.

top25.query: SELECT $2||coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(key)::text||$3||public.core_canonical_v1(value),$4 ORDER BY public.core_utf16_sort_v1(key)),$5)||$6        FROM jsonb_each(v)

SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object($4,l.state,$5,l.attempt_id,$6,ep.permit_epoch::text,$7,l.descriptor) ORDER BY l.lease_id),$8::jsonb)             FROM public.execution_quota_leases l JOIN public.execution_permits ep ON ep.attempt_id=l.attempt_id WHERE l.request_id=(SELECT request_id FROM public.attempts WHERE id=core_preflight_v1.attempt_id)
SELECT public.core_supplier_settle_v1(row.attempt,(row.value->>$110)::uuid,CASE WHEN row.value->>$111 IS NULL THEN $112 ELSE $113 END||row.attempt||$114||(row.value->>$115))
UPDATE public.execution_quota_leases SET state=$8 WHERE request_id=qid AND state IN ($9,$10)

snap=public.core_evidence_snapshot_v1(a,$99,ev->>$100,CASE WHEN seen_final AND (basis IS DISTINCT FROM $101 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT $102 FROM jsonb_object_keys(prices) p2 WHERE NOT p2=ANY(merged_finals))) THEN $103 WHEN cardinality(merged_finals)>$104 OR merged<>$105::jsonb THEN $106 ELSE $107 END,merged,merged_finals,cur.id,(raw->>$108)::uuid,(x->>$109)::numeric,(x->>$110)::boolean)
SELECT $2||coalesce(string_agg(public.core_canonical_v1(value),$3 ORDER BY n),$4)||$5        FROM jsonb_array_elements(v) WITH ORDINALITY a(value,n)

SELECT *                FROM public.core_evidence_receipts r WHERE r.attempt_id=(ev->>$4)::uuid AND r.origin_identity=ev->>$5 AND r.source=ev->>$6 AND r.source_revision=(ev->>$7)::numeric AND r.revision_claim
